term: well-founded contingent portion of one actual grounding cone
definition: Instantiate the existing ExplanatoryAdequacy.Founded predicate on the positive-existence arena and coneFacts account. Only reason arrows whose source and target are contingent existence facts within this cone enter the well-founded relation. Grounding involving a necessary ancestor is unrestricted by this premise; no foundation or exemption from explanation is asserted for that necessary being.
note: Reuse of the existing Profile, complete cone, positive existence-fact constructor and Founded relation, not a new ontology or source reading. This is a representation of already selected grounds, not an automatic philosophical fact-to-concrete bridge. See the contingent-only foundation section of docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md.
